$comment: User-scope MCP servers. install.sh registers each entry below with `claude mcp add --scope user` (installer/scripts/register_mcp.py), which is what actually reaches Claude Code. Add VAR_NAME-style placeholders (with the dollar-brace syntax) and define them in secrets/secrets.env when a server needs an API key; they are substituted before registration.
$caveat: 2026-08-10 measured: Claude Code does NOT read ~/.claude/mcp.json — user-scope servers load from ~/.claude.json (mcpServers) only. Tested with both the globalServers and the mcpServers key; neither appeared in `claude mcp list`. The rendered mcp.json is therefore a record, not an active config, and registration goes through the `claude mcp add` path instead. Bare command names are resolved to an absolute path at registration time (PATH, then ~/.local/bin), because hooks and MCP servers do not inherit a login shell's PATH.
